home.heroHeadline:
WE COME TO YOUR LOT.
YOUR RIG LEAVES SPOTLESS.
home.heroLead: EB Wash Mobil brings commercial pressure washing straight to your yard. We wash semi-trucks, trailers, reefers, and heavy equipment where they sit so your drivers stay on route.
home.servicesSubtitle: We bring our own water, power, and commercial wash gear straight to your lot. No driving to truck bays, no waiting in line.

serviceCards.title: Semi Truck Wash
serviceCards.desc: Cabs, hoods, grilles, fuel tanks, and wheels. Hand foamed, scrubbed, and pressure washed.

serviceCards.desc: Scheduled washes for multiple tractors and trailers. Nights and weekends available.

serviceCards.title: Trailer & Reefer Wash
serviceCards.desc: Dry vans, reefers, flatbeds, and containers. Salt, road film, and grime stripped clean.

advantageSteps.title: We Roll Up Self-Contained

advantageSteps.title: Your Fleet Leaves Spotless
advantageSteps.desc: Tractors and trailers are hand-scrubbed, power-rinsed, and ready to roll out on schedule with zero driver overtime or yard congestion.

contact.faqSubtitle: Here are quick answers to the most common questions fleet dispatchers and owner-operators ask us.

faqs.q: Do we need to supply water or power on our lot?
faqs.a: No. Our mobile wash units are 100% self-contained with large-capacity onboard water tanks and commercial gas pressure washers. We can wash in gravel lots, remote yards, or commercial terminals with zero connections.

faqs.q: Can you wash our fleet while drivers are on rest?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely. We often schedule fleet cleaning over weekends, early mornings, or during scheduled 10-hour rest breaks so your equipment is spotless without losing a single hour of driving time.

faqs.q: Are your detergents safe for vehicle decals and aluminum?
faqs.a: Yes. We use premium commercial-grade vehicle soaps and neutral cleaners that strip diesel grime and salt without fading vinyl logos or oxidizing polished aluminum tanks and wheels.

faqs.q: Do you offer recurring fleet contract discounts?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer discounted rates for recurring accounts (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly) and volume discounts for yards with 5+ units washed during the same visit.
